- We can provide a sample CSV export of our remittance file (attached) and a signed bank letter from our finance admin (attached) for ACH routing.
- If ACH prenote/window fails, we need a fallback plan: same-day wire available with a standard wire fee and beneficiary reference format.

Attached: sunridge_sample_remit.csv, sunridge_bank_letter.pdf, sunridge_w9.pdf

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — bank letters, PO remittance format

Will —

Appreciate the attachments and the clear summary. Quick answers below, plus a few asks so our payments team can finalize mapping:

1) PO/ship-to tags: We prefer per-invoice a remit block that includes: PO_NUMBER, LINE_NUMBER, SHIP_TO_CODE, INVOICE_AMOUNT, INVOICE_DATE, and REMIT_REFERENCE. For split shipments under one PO line, put each ship-to as a separate row with the same PO_NUMBER but unique SHIP_TO_CODE and LINE_NUMBER suffix (e.g., 12-1, 12-2). That lets our AP automation create separate settlement lines.

2) CSV schema: Your sample looks close. Please add a header row that exactly matches the field names above. We can accept additional custom fields but they will be ignored for auto-match.

3) ACH testing: We run a prenote window when new bank details are provided (typically 2 business days). For faster onboarding we offer an expedited ACH test (one micro-deposit of <$0.50) and a verified same-day wire fallback if prenote fails or you require immediate first-pay settlement. If you choose expedited ACH, our finance ops will schedule the micro-deposit for T+1 (business).

4) Wire fallback: If ACH fails, we route to our wire desk. Please confirm that Sunridge will accept the standard wire fee and provide the beneficiary tax reference to include on wire remittance.

Next steps I need from you: a CSV with the exact header row (or confirm you will rename headers), and a signed copy of the bank letter showing authorized signatory + routing numbers (the pdf you provided looks valid but we need the page with signature). Once we have those, Marissa will kick off the prenote / expedited flow.

Looping Marissa and Jordan for scheduling and PO tagging questions.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
